name: Mizunomiya Wakaba
source:
Race: Hume

[url=/c132080]Reiri[/url]'s best friend. Unlike Reiri's outgoing nature, Wakaba is quiet and reserved. Unlike most Humes, she doesn't seem to hold any particular grudge against Vamps.
